traits.name: Sunbeetle Armor
traits.text:
The Knight’s armor is perpetually
slick. Any attempts to grapple the Knight
have disadvantage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text:
Magic cannot put the Knight
to sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The Knight has advantage
on saving throws against spells and other
magical effects.

traits.name: Command Fey
traits.text: As a member of the Court of Arcadia, the Knight can cast dominate monster (DC 12) at will on any fey creature or elf.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The Knight’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The Knight can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: heroism, shield of faith

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The Knight makes four attacks
with its rapiers, or makes two attacks and casts
heroism or shield of faith on an ally.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
